title: The Skybase Foundation is a Prime Foundation whose mandate is bounded to supporting Skybase alone
content:
A.6.1.1.4.2.1.1.3.1.1.5 records the Skybase Foundation as "the Prime Foundation associated with Skybase," with the mandate "to support the development, growth, and adoption of Skybase."

The placement is telling: the Foundation is a *parameter of the Agent Creation Primitive Instance*, set at the moment the Agent came into existence and alongside its SubProxy account and StarGuard contract. The off-chain legal vehicle is treated as part of the Agent's constitution rather than as an arrangement made afterwards.

The mandate wording is narrow in scope and broad in means. It names three objectives — development, growth, adoption — and no activities, so the Foundation's discretion over *how* is wide while its discretion over *for whom* is nil. A Prime Foundation cannot justify work by appeal to general ecosystem benefit; the beneficiary is a single named Agent.

This is what makes per-Agent foundations different from one central foundation. Costs and conflicts of interest localize to the Agent that generates them, and an Agent's off-chain support capacity scales with that Agent rather than being rationed centrally.
description: Naming a per-Agent foundation gives Skybase an off-chain counterpart with a remit scoped to one Agent's development, growth and adoption rather than to the wider ecosystem.
